title: GTA 6 leaker threatens to release full playable version if demands not met
summary: A hacker known as CyberLeek demands money and issues ultimatums to Rockstar Games to leak a playable build of GTA 6.

title: Konami confirms new waves of Silent Hill games for coming years
summary: The Japanese company plans to release a second and third wave of titles in the horror saga, according to recent reports.

title: Squadron 42 arrives on Steam after 14 years of development
summary: The Star Citizen campaign mode finally has a page on Valve's store, though without a confirmed release date.

title: ARC Raiders details weapon amplifiers and possible separation of PvE and PvP modes
summary: Embark Studios' shooter shows its progression system and the executive producer suggests splitting the experience into two distinct modes.

title: Deadlock surpasses Team Fortress 2's all-time concurrent player record
summary: Valve's early-phase MOBA peaks at 184,000 concurrent users and adds a new hero with chess-based animations.

title: Nivalis Nights warns it won't be a cozy game despite its appearance
summary: Developers clarify that the absence of combat doesn't imply a relaxed experience, but that players must earn their survival in the cyberpunk city.
